title: Lumen Reef
theme: A small glowing jellyfish drifts in a dark reef as currents of light flow down four lanes. The player taps each current when its light reaches the reef, keeping the bioluminescence bright.
mechanics: Notes travel down four lanes toward a hit line at the bottom
Tap or press 1-4 when a note crosses the hit line
Timing windows award Perfect, Good, or Miss judgments
Complete authored levels to brighten the reef and raise your score
Missing notes breaks your combo but does not end the run
